messages.en: This cake's shaped like a heart, right? It's so pretty!
Yeah, I just used a mould. Want to try making one together?

senses.en_definition: To be in a particular place, position, or state.

messages.en: I'm already out front of the shop. Where are you?
I'm behind the shop, near the parking area. Turns out I went to the wrong entrance.
No wonder I couldn't see you. Just wait there. I'll come over.

senses.en_definition: To come to an end; to finish or expire.
To have a particular outcome; to end in something.

messages.en: Is the match over yet? Who won?
Yeah, it finished one-all. The equaliser went in at the last minute!
Ah, what a shame I missed it. Must've been wild, right?
He told me to get lost, so I just went home.
Are you home already? I want to give you a quick call.
